lines: Granola fills out your notes from the call.
Then the audio is gone.
Here's how Lynkk and Granola compare, feature by feature, as of October 2026.
Granola is an AI notepad. You type rough notes during the call, it listens to your computer's audio, and fills them out afterwards.
It uses the audio for the transcript, and doesn't keep it.
Lynkk records the call itself, and turns it into a transcript and a Meeting Brief, with the audio kept.
With Lynkk, the recording stays with the note.
Every timestamp in the Meeting Brief plays the recording from that moment, so you can hear exactly how something was said.
On Pro, the meeting bot can record video too.
Some calls need a bot.
Lynkk's bot joins Google Meet, Zoom and Teams links. Paste a link, or turn on calendar auto-join.
Granola has no bot, and you start each note yourself.
s4.chapter: A bot when you can't attend

lines: On the Mac, Lynkk notices calls in Zoom, Meet, Teams, Slack huddles, WhatsApp, FaceTime and Webex, and asks if you want to record.
Nothing joins the call. Both sides are recorded on two channels, so your lines are labelled You.
It stops by itself when the call ends.
Every action item comes with an owner, a due date and a priority.
Send them to Jira from the note, one issue per item. Granola connects Jira through Zapier.
On Pro, Ask Lynkk answers only from your own notes, with citation chips, and Play from takes you to the moment.
It can also create a calendar event, share a note, mark a task done, or create a Jira issue, each one behind a confirm card.
With Google Calendar connected, Lynkk emails you a morning briefing on days you have meetings.
Who you're meeting, the last note with them, and how many action items are still open between you.
On Pro, ask @Lynkk in a Slack channel, and it answers in the thread from your own notes, with sources.
s8.chapter: Before the call, and in Slack

lines: To be fair, Granola is the better fit for some people.
If you like typing your own notes, need Windows, or need more than 17 languages, look at Granola.
Its free plan also includes chat over your last 30 days of meetings. Ask Lynkk is part of Pro.
So, the short version.
Pick Lynkk if you want the recording kept, a bot for the calls you can't attend, and tasks that go straight to Jira.
And Lynkk never trains on your conversations.
Lynkk records the call, writes the brief, and hands your tasks to Jira.
Start free at lynkk.ai.
